obligations: Validate a current approved Safety-referenced grant before every operation.
Enforce explicit operation, context-category, sensitivity, item, and horizon limits.
Use only bounded caller-supplied records and retain no personal data.
Preserve source identifiers and explain priority, recommendation, and decision evidence.
Return reminder views and schedule proposals without delivery or booking.
Keep all rankings and assistance outputs advisory and user-owned.
failure_semantics: Invalid, unauthorized, ambiguous, sensitive, or over-budget requests fail closed before analysis.
